$comment: The MonoRail standard: the entity types MonoRail knows. OpenMetadata v2.0.x (fields pinned to 2.0.8) plus MonoRail's own. Docs: docs/standard/. Field tables there are generated from this file: node scripts/standard-docs.cjs.

categories.name: Semantic
categories.summary: A dbt project's semantic layer: semantic models, metrics and saved queries.

categories.name: Databases
categories.summary: Database services, databases, schemas, tables and stored procedures.

byReference.name: Messaging
byReference.summary: Messaging services and topics, such as Kafka and Kinesis.

byReference.name: ML Models
byReference.summary: ML model services and ML models.

entities.name: Subagent
entities.summary: A helper agent defined in a Markdown file with a header, for Claude Code or pi.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Handle the backend hands out; never a path.

fields.name: tool
fields.description: `claude` or `pi`: the agent that reads the file.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: `user` (home folder), `project` (an allowed repo) or `builtin` (MonoRail's own, read-only).

fields.name: repo
fields.description: The allowed repo a project subagent lives in.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The header's `name`: lowercase letters and hyphens.

fields.name: description
fields.description: When the agent should use it.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Claude: `sonnet`, `opus`, `haiku`, `inherit` or a model id; pi: a model id. Unset = the chat's model.

fields.name: tools
fields.description: Tools it may use. Unset = the default tools.

fields.name: location
fields.description: Where the file is, relative to the home folder or the repo.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Last change to the file, ms since epoch.

fields.name: customized
fields.description: A built-in the user has made their own copy of.

fields.name: extraFields
fields.description: Header fields MonoRail does not edit; kept as they are on save.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Built-ins only: what it needs or how it is used.

fields.name: problem
fields.description: Why the agent would skip this file, if it would.

entities.name: Flow
entities.summary: A saved chain of agent steps that runs in one of Chat's allowed repos.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The flow's id.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Its name.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What it does.

fields.name: folder
fields.description: The allowed repo, by name, where agent steps run by default.

fields.name: kinds
fields.description: The kinds of step it uses.

fields.name: steps
fields.description: How many steps it has.

fields.name: agentName
fields.description: The agent that runs its steps.

fields.name: updated
fields.description: Last change, ms since epoch.

fields.name: runs7d
fields.description: Runs in the last 7 days.

fields.name: running
fields.description: A run is going now.

fields.name: error
fields.description: Why the flow could not be read, if it could not.

entities.name: Prompt template
entities.summary: A reusable prompt. Every save adds a version; nothing is overwritten.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The template's id.

fields.name: versions
fields.description: Every saved version, oldest first: `version`, `name`, `text`, `savedAt`. The last one is current.

entities.name: Note
entities.summary: A Markdown note in Notes' local git repo. Explore shows its summary, not its text.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The file's name without `.md`.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The first line.

fields.name: excerpt
fields.description: The start of the text.

fields.name: updated
fields.description: Last change to the file, ms since epoch.

fields.name: words
fields.description: Word count.

entities.name: Bookmark
entities.summary: A saved web address or local path.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The bookmark's id.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Its name, up to 120 characters.

fields.name: description
fields.description: A note about it, up to 500 characters.

fields.name: target
fields.description: An http(s) address or an absolute local path.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: Always `bookmark`.

fields.name: parentId
fields.description: The bookmark folder it is in; `null` at the top.

fields.name: color
fields.description: A `#rrggbb` color, or empty.

entities.name: Bookmark folder
entities.summary: A folder that groups bookmarks. Same record as a bookmark, with no target.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The folder's id.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Its name, up to 120 characters.

fields.name: description
fields.description: A note about it, up to 500 characters.

fields.name: target
fields.description: Always empty.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: Always `folder`.

fields.name: parentId
fields.description: The folder it is in; `null` at the top.

fields.name: color
fields.description: A `#rrggbb` color, or empty.

entities.name: Scheduled task
entities.summary: A task in Windows Task Scheduler.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The task's name.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Its folder in Task Scheduler.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Its description.

fields.name: command
fields.description: What it runs.

fields.name: schedule
fields.description: When it runs, in words.

fields.name: state
fields.description: Ready, Running, Disabled and so on.

fields.name: lastRun
fields.description: When it last ran, or `null`.

fields.name: nextRun
fields.description: When it runs next, or `null`.

fields.name: result
fields.description: The last run's result code, or `null`.

fields.name: writable
fields.description: Whether MonoRail may change it.

entities.name: Flashcard deck
entities.summary: A deck of spaced repetition cards with its own daily limit and target recall.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The deck's id.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Its name.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What it covers.

fields.name: newPerDay
fields.description: New cards per day (default 20).

fields.name: retention
fields.description: Target recall, 0 to 1 (default 0.9).

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: When it was made, ms since epoch.

fields.name: counts
fields.description: Cards by state: new (today's allowance), newTotal, learning, review and so on.

fields.name: today
fields.description: Studied today: `new` and `reviews`.

entities.name: Flashcard
entities.summary: One card: a Markdown front and back, scheduled with FSRS-5.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The card's id.

fields.name: deckId
fields.description: The deck it belongs to.

fields.name: front
fields.description: The question side.

fields.name: back
fields.description: The answer side.

fields.name: state
fields.description: `new`, `learning`, `review` or `relearning`.

fields.name: due
fields.description: When it is next due, ms since epoch.

fields.name: intervalDays
fields.description: Days between the last review and the next.

fields.name: reps
fields.description: Times reviewed.

fields.name: lapses
fields.description: Times forgotten after being learned.

fields.name: suspended
fields.description: Left out of study.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: When it was made, ms since epoch.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Last change, ms since epoch.

entities.name: Semantic model
entities.summary: A MetricFlow semantic model: entities, dimensions and measures over one dbt model.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The semantic model's name.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What it describes.

fields.name: model
fields.description: The dbt model it is defined on, e.g. `fct_orders`.

fields.name: relation
fields.description: The warehouse table it reads: `database`, `schema` and `name`. This is the link to a Table.

fields.name: defaultTimeDimension
fields.description: The time dimension measures use by default.

fields.name: primaryEntity
fields.description: Its primary entity.

fields.name: entities
fields.description: Join keys: `name` and `type` (primary, foreign, unique, natural).

fields.name: dimensions
fields.description: What it can be grouped by: `name`, `type` (categorical or time), `grain`, `description`.

fields.name: measures
fields.description: What it adds up: `name`, `agg`, `description`.

entities.name: Metric
entities.summary: A MetricFlow metric. Not OpenMetadata's Metric entity, which MonoRail has not adopted yet.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The metric's name.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Its display name.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What it measures.

fields.name: type
fields.description: `simple`, `ratio`, `cumulative`, `derived` or `conversion`.

fields.name: definition
fields.description: How it is worked out, in words, e.g. "Sum of order_total".

fields.name: filter
fields.description: A where filter on the metric itself, as written.

fields.name: measures
fields.description: Measures it reads, directly or through its input metrics.

fields.name: inputMetrics
fields.description: Metrics it is built from.

fields.name: semanticModels
fields.description: Semantic models it reads.

fields.name: dimensions
fields.description: Group-by names it can be split by, e.g. `customer__region`.

entities.name: Saved query
entities.summary: A MetricFlow saved query: metrics, group-bys and filters under one name.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The saved query's name.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What it answers.

fields.name: metrics
fields.description: Metrics it returns.

fields.name: groupBy
fields.description: Group-bys it splits them by.

fields.name: where
fields.description: Filters, as written.

entities.name: Database Service
entities.summary: A service such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Postgres or DuckDB that hosts databases.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier of this database service instance.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name that identifies this database service.

fields.name: fullyQualifiedName
fields.description: FullyQualifiedName same as `name`.

fields.name: displayName
fields.description: Display Name that identifies this database service.

fields.name: serviceType
fields.description: Type of database service such as MySQL, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Postgres...

fields.name: description
fields.description: Description of a database service instance.

fields.name: connection
fields.description: How to connect to the service. Secrets in it are never shown.

fields.name: pipelines
fields.description: References to pipelines deployed for this database service to extract metadata, usage, lineage etc..

fields.name: testConnectionResult
fields.description: Last test connection results for this service

fields.name: tags
fields.description: Tags for this Database Service.

fields.name: style
fields.description: Color and icon for the entity in the UI.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Metadata version of the entity.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Last update time corresponding to the new version of the entity in Unix epoch time milliseconds.

fields.name: updatedBy
fields.description: User who made the update.

fields.name: impersonatedBy
fields.description: Bot user that performed the action on behalf of the actual user.

fields.name: owners
fields.description: Owners of this database service.

fields.name: href
fields.description: Link to the resource corresponding to this database service.

fields.name: followers
fields.description: Followers of this entity.

fields.name: changeDescription
fields.description: Change that lead to this version of the entity.

fields.name: incrementalChangeDescription
fields.description: Change that lead to this version of the entity.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: When `true` indicates the entity has been soft deleted.

fields.name: entityStatus
fields.description: Status of the entity.

fields.name: dataProducts
fields.description: List of data products this entity is part of.

fields.name: dataContract
fields.description: Reference to the data contract for this entity.

fields.name: domains
fields.description: Domains the Database service belongs to.

fields.name: ingestionRunner
fields.description: The ingestion agent responsible for executing the ingestion pipeline.
